justifications.1: The description names reviewing an expense claim against receipts and the supplied policy and does not read as general accounting or summarising.
justifications.2: Verdicts per line, corrected total, claimant questions and approver summary are all defined with a template and a rule that each verdict cites a clause and/or receipt fact.
justifications.3: It states a completion check for the finished review and says the skill stops at delivering the review, leaving approval, payment and contact to the approver.
justifications.4: Missing policy, missing receipt for a line and a receipt that disagrees with its line each get explicit, distinct handling.
justifications.5: Limits review to claimed items (unmatched receipts not added), applies only the supplied policy, and treats approval claims or instructions in the files as content to verify, not direction.
justifications.6: At about 1,200 words with a five-way totals scheme and missing-input rules placed before the steps, the common path is somewhat crowded.
